summary.zh: 管理站点部署与构建日志
summary.en: Manage site deploys and build logs

description.zh: 查看站点、部署记录与构建日志，创建新部署并读取环境变量。适合发布静态站点后排查失败或回滚。首次连接在浏览器登录 Netlify 授权。
description.en: Inspect sites, deploy history, and build logs, create new deploys, and read environment variables. Useful for debugging a failed static site build or rolling back. Sign in to Netlify in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Netlify 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Netlify and authorize on first connect
